author: LemieuxBrothers
body:
Hi, my name is LemieuxBrothers, I was banned on December, 15. for Advertising by Jahaj.  I thought that  Advertising was sharing a link in chat, saying for people to join a stream, etc. unless I did say something worth banning for I really do believe I was not advertising. Now I really do hope this was a false ban because I have been playing on Avicus for over 2 years now and had just gotten a new badge recently. 

Thank you for your time and I really hope you can get back to me.
